decisions.boundary_condition: Carry forward only the general walking-distance preference; do not infer a specific walk-time limit, destination, budget, or rating unless the current request supplies it.
decisions.canonical_value: On coastal or beach-oriented trips, prefer lodging on or near the beach or ocean, ideally within walking distance.
decisions.condition: When choosing lodging for a coastal or beach-oriented trip.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize properties on the beach or close enough to walk, subject to constraints stated for the current trip.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not apply this preference to non-coastal trips or when the current request states a different location priority.
decisions.name: prefer_beach_proximate_hotels
decisions.preference_value: Prefers lodging on or near the beach or ocean, ideally within walking distance.
decisions.rationale: These candidates are true aliases supported by the same repeated examples: both express a reusable preference for beach- or ocean-proximate lodging on coastal trips, while treating any exact walk-time, budget, rating, or destination constraint as request-specific.
